status.nb: 104 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Belutsjistan.

summary.en: Iran says it struck a US military radar in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike on southern Iran, while Pakistan’s security forces reported killing 74 terrorists in raids across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. In North Waziristan two soldiers were killed and 14 terrorists were killed in an operation, and two women died in a hit-and-run on Murree Road. The Taliban-run Afghan government’s new road to China remains unusable because the border is closed. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran sier de slo et amerikansk militærradar i Bahrain som gjengjeldelse for et angrep på sørlige Iran, mens Pakistans sikkerhetsstyrker rapporterte at de drepte 74 terrorister i razziaer over Khyber Pakhtunkhwa og Balochistan. I Nord-Waziristan ble to soldater drept og 14 terrorister drept i en operasjon, og to kvinner døde i en påkjørsel på Murree Road. Den afghanske regjeringen under Taliban sin nye vei til Kina er fortsatt ubrukelig fordi grensen er stengt. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
